QuestInfo.0: #p9120005# in Showa Town is intensively involved in developing a new product. You should learn more about it.
QuestInfo.1:
In order to make the health food, bitter cucumber, #t040036# and #t04000223# are required. Help #p9120005# gather the ingredients required.

QuestInfo.2: Not only does this taste awful, it's not even healthy.

0.0: As the suburb supermarkets expand, all the mom-and-pop shops like ours are going to be driven out of business.
0.1: That's why I'm hoping you can help me develop a new product they can't compete with, and revitalize our business!

yes.0: Wonderful! Then I'll let you in on my plan.
yes.1: Metabolic syndrome is serious problem these days. So my plan is to sell a product specially designed to prevent it! I call it Bitter Cucumber.
yes.2: If you soak #t04000223# in #t04000036#, the resulting dish has been shown to prevent the disease.
yes.3: Please bring me 100 each of #t04000036#s and \n#t04000223#s. I'll reward you for your work. Thanks!

no.0: I know I could create a hit product, but no one has faith in me.

1.0: Wow, you gathered them already? Seems like you got them all. Please accept this small gift.
1.1: I'm sure I can make a hit product with these!

item.0: Oh no, this is not enough to make a quality product.
